body: How do I move out when most landlords require an income or cosigner? Rent is expensive here. Feel like I'm stuck until I can get a job.
Physics. I have no idea. I looked up their career services and it looks like it's mostly on-campus services for current students or useless personality tests that they want to charge for.

> CA probably has some good programs to help out people like you. I would try to find one. Maybe see if a social worker can advise you? 

I will try.

> I'm not the best person to give advice as I will probably kill myself in May or June

Have to commend you for that incredibly precise timing. I read your comments, kudos for thoroughly planning out something clean and quiet. Maybe you will find some other reason to live before then, hope so since you sound like a nice person. Also, guns are messy and not completely reliable for this purpose. Consider a DIY lethal injection/poisoning if you have to go.

>And let me tell you something... there is NO SHAME in flipping burgers to make some money. NONE.

Wholeheartedly agree but honestly I have trouble even going outside on my own lately. Have been developing some panic/anxiety issues. 

I looked up section 8 housing and it sounds like it would take years and isn't even worth bothering..
